text:
maya: FYI incoming external assessment next Tue 09:00 PST. Need a short runbook for pre-retest snapshot + ephemeral access for assessors. Can we lock down scope by EOD?

john: ack. which environments are in-scope? staging only or prod too?

maya: staging + sanitized-prod-logs. Not full prod access. We need: RBAC snapshot, KMS audit logs, exported logs bundle, and evidence of key rotation windows.

sophie: tagging the checklist items I own: create ephemeral assessor role, generate presigned evidence bundle link, confirm CloudTrail/Stackdriver exports.

ops-oncall: on ephemeral role — propose timeboxed IAM policy with these perms: `logs:Describe`, `logs:GetLogEvents`, `kms:Decrypt` (limited to audit keys), and `s3:GetObject` on evidence bucket. Example JSON snippet we used before: `{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:FilterLogEvents","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/*"}]}`

maya: perfect. sec-qa — will you draft the assessor access checklist for packaging? include MD5 checksums for artifacts.

sec-qa: will do. Q: do assessors need direct KMS access or just pre-wrapped artifacts? We prefer pre-wrapped artifacts signed by our HSM to avoid granting `kms:Decrypt`.

john: agree — we can sign bundles with HSM/KMS and give assessors the signed blob + verification key. That avoids exposing raw plaintext keys.

sophie: for retest window, we need a 2-hour slot and a dryrun prior day. Proposed: dryrun Mon 16:00 PST, assessment Tue 09:00-11:00. Ops, can we schedule autoscaling freeze and disable deploys during that window?

ops-oncall: yes. I will open a maintenance window and flip `deploybot` to read-only for that timeframe. Also will snapshot KV caches and export active model-serving configs: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://admin.internal/v1/config > config-2026-03-25.json`

maya: include the exact snapshot commands in the runbook. Need audit-log retention proof: export last 90 days of CloudTrail and show integrity hashes.

sec-qa: added to checklist: `cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time '2026-01-01' --end-time '2026-03-25' > ct-export.json` then `sha256sum ct-export.json > ct-export.sha256`. Link to JIRA: SEC-721 (assessor intake & evidence packaging).

john: vuln triage note: we need mapping from pen-test findings -> jira ticket -> remediation owner -> retest criteria. I created a small table in the ticket; will attach PRs for fixes.

maya: good. For KMS integration questions from assessors: be prepared to show key policy, key rotation schedule, and audit logs for key usage. Do NOT hand over key material.

sophie: copy. Also plan for ephemeral DB creds for read-only query access. We'll use the `db-temp-creds` flow: `auth service` issues creds with 1h TTL and logs via audit service.

ops-oncall: note — we need to whitelist assessor IPs for the window. Please DM me the IPs once we have them.

pen-test-bot: Reminder: please upload assessor proof-of-identity to SEC-721 before access is granted.

maya: action items recap:
- sophie: create ephemeral IAM role + policy, pre-signed evidence bundle generation script, and dryrun.
- sec-qa: finalize checklist + export commands + sha256 proofs.
- john: map findings -> tickets and attach remediation criteria.
- ops-oncall: maintenance window, freeze deploys, snapshot commands, whitelist IPs.
- maya: coordinate assessor intake and sign-off.

sophie: I'll post the role YAML and the bundle script by EOD. sample bundle command I'm using: `tar -czf evidence-2026-03-25.tar.gz logs/ config-2026-03-25.json && openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /path/to/hsm-key -out evidence.sig evidence-2026-03-25.tar.gz`

sec-qa: pushed checklist to SEC-721 ticket, added dryrun checklist and evidence naming conventions (artifact name, sha tag, who sealed it).

john: I'll add a column to the mapping for 'retest success criteria' (e.g., fixed patch deployed + regression test results).

ops-oncall: maintenance window created: 2026-03-25T16:00-18:00 PST (dryrun) and 2026-03-26T09:00-11:00 PST (assessment). Deploybot set to read-only.

maya: thanks. one more compliance ask — audit team wants a signed attestation that no code changes will be merged to the assessed branch during the window. Sophie can you add that to the bundle metadata?

sophie: will include attestation file: `ATTACHMENT:NO_CHANGES_ATTEST.txt` with sha and signer.

maya: great. we'll reconvene after dryrun to confirm access flow. :thumbsup:

john: noted. ping me if any blocker on remediations.

ops-oncall: getting IPs now; will post in thread once available.

sec-qa: all set on checklist, marking items as TODO in SEC-721.

maya: closing loop — everyone: please update SEC-721 with status and tag `@pen-test-bot` once artifacts are uploaded so the assessor gets automated notice.

pen-test-bot: Automated notice will send to assessor contact after `evidence-bucket` upload and checksum verification.
